feeds.title: What Great Grandma Ate
feeds.description: I'm Jean and I'm a Nutritional Therapist (NTP) living in Southern California with my husband and 2 dog babies. On WGGA, you'll find simple and easy gluten, dairy, and processed sugar-free recipes that focus on quality nutrients, and of course, never sacrifice taste. I believe that the food you love should love you back, making you feel amazing inside and out.

feeds.title: Nutrition Diets Blog
feeds.description: Get all the latest information about nutrition, health & wellness, lifestyle tips, and chronic disease prevention. Carmen Martinez-Vidal is a fully qualified and registered Nutritional Therapy Practitioner & Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP) Coach who received her degree in Health Science: Nutritional Therapy from The University of Westminster in London, UK.

feeds.title: Redeeming Wellness Blog
feeds.description: I'm Leslie Bumpas, founder of Redeeming Wellness and a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner. I work with clients like you to help them navigate the confusing minefield of nutritional information. In my work, I emphasize the importance of bio-individuality and nutrient-dense food. I support your specific nutritional needs and provide a blueprint for long-lasting wellness.

feeds.title: Health = Wealth Nutritional Therapy Blog
feeds.description: I'm Karri Ball, a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner, and owner of Health=Wealth. I am a health, wellness, and fitness advocate and believe that health is the ultimate wealth. I help exhausted women restore their energy so they can get shit done!

feeds.title: Nutrition With Confidence Blog
feeds.description: Natalie guides nature-seeking & courageous individuals (like you) to reconnect with their own confidence and self-love to overcome and reverse. She does all of this through nutritional consultations, medical nutritional protocol guides, health blogs, and online courses which focus on healing your root cause... your gut.

feeds.title: Just Take A Bite Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Mary - a Nutritional Therapy Practitioner, feeding expert, and mom of four (used-to-be) selective eaters. I help parents make the connection between what their kids eat and how they think, feel, and behave. I empower parents to be intentional about nourishing their children in order for them to thrive in all aspects of life.

feeds.title: Emily Morrow Blog
feeds.description: In this blog, you can find the latest info on discovering all that this life has to offer. Emily wants to challenge her readers to seek greatness and find Joy through gratitude, good food, movement, and healthier living. Emily Morrow is a certified Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner (FNTP) and Integrative Health Practitioner (IHP) transforming lives virtually through root cause nutrition.

feeds.title: With Candor Blog
feeds.description: Emily Blasik is a Nutritional Therapy Practitioner dedicated to helping women with a history of disordered eating ditch the yo-yo dieting, balance their hormones, and reclaim their health and vitality with real food.

feeds.title: From the Roots Blog
feeds.description: HI! I'm Candace. I'm a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner and have my Bachelor of Arts in Business Management and Psychology from Emmanuel College. My food blog, From The Roots, provides easy, family-friendly recipes that are also healthy! My dishes explore ways of pruning up classic favorites, whether it be with a southern flair or just introducing a new kind of health.

feeds.title: Megan Crozier Blog
feeds.description: I'm Megan Crozier. I'm a Nutritional Therapy Practitioner and Restorative Wellness Practitioner. I help health-conscious women learn how to properly nourish their body and eat for their metabolism & hormones so that they can have more energy and lose weight in a healthy, sustainable way without diet obsession or food rules.

feeds.title: Nourish Nutritional Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Lesley is a Registered Nutritional Therapist, Nutritional Therapy Practitioner and Nutritionist. Nourish - Nutritional Therapy uses a wide range of tools to assess and identify potential nutritional imbalances; working with the individual to understand how these may contribute to their symptoms and health concerns.

feeds.title: Joey Anderson Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Joey Anderson. I'm a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner. I've had a lifelong passion for food and cooking. I help women create a sane, sustainable, mindful, and intuitive way to eat that works for them for the long game. I help women get off the blood sugar roller coaster and get to the root of their digestive issues so they can lose weight and balance hormones so they can show up to life with energy and vitality.

feeds.title: Ginger Martinson Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ginger and I am a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner. My goal as a Nutritional Therapist is to help you reach your health goals by finding the path that is right for you.

feeds.title: Food By Mars
feeds.description: Food by Mars is a nutrition coaching practice and food blog with hundreds of AIP diet, Paleo diet, and Whole30 meal ideas from Nutritional Therapy Practitioner, Alison Marras.

feeds.title: Amy Gray Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Check out our library of nutritional health blogs that are based on tried and true holistic methods. I'm Amy, a functional nutrition therapist based in Denver Colorado. My mission is to support you in finding 'wellness' from diet and lifestyle modifications. My goal is to assist you, as you take control of your health!

feeds.title: Melano Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Hola, I'm Diane. I'm a Functional Nutritional Therapist, Certified Spiritual Coach and I have Multiple Sclerosis. My mission is to assist you on your own journey toward reaching your optimum health. We will work together, every step of the way, to create a delicious, nutrient-dense diet that helps you feel and perform your best.

feeds.title: Carole Layton Nutritional Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I Carole. I am a certified Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner and am very excited to help you on your path to wellness. Your body is an amazing machine and if you are ready to experience the powerful transformation that eating a nutrient dense, whole foods diet can provide, you are in the right place.

feeds.title: Be Well With Candice Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Candice. Be Well With Candice brings you nutritional support from a certified Functional Nutritional Therapy and Restorative Wellness Practitioner. Here you will discover significant support, resources, and guidance from a girl that has once been sick herself and totally gets it. We're in this together.

feeds.title: Embrace Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Wilma Shaw. My blog offers advice on nutrition and provides life-changing tools to help you succeed today, tomorrow, and for the rest of your life. I am Board Certified in Holistic Nutrition and a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner. I share my hard-earned knowledge with you so you too can live a vibrant life through real food nutrition and enjoy a healthy lifestyle for decades to come.

feeds.title: Nuanced Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: I'm Maida Ference - a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner. My passion is empowering you to connect to your body, to help you discover the food and lifestyle choices that are obstacles to your best quality of life. We'll address root causes, rather than treating symptoms. You can expect encouraging, non-judgmental guidance with respect to your health concerns, priorities, personality, history, and life circumstances.

feeds.title: Cait Crowell Blog
feeds.description: I'm Caitlin - a Nutritional Therapy Practitioner, truth-seeker, and empowering motivator. Welcome to the Cait Crowell Blog. Where you can find the most inspiring interviews from my podcast, the most helpful tips, and tricks when it comes to a balanced approach to holistic health, details from my own health journey, and real-life client case studies, all things real life.

feeds.title: K R Nutritional Therapy Blog
feeds.description: I'm Karen Ring, a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner here to help you reclaim your life. Having have lived with chronic pain and fatigue for many years I know how hopeless it can feel. When you work with me you could experience benefits such as more energy throughout your day balanced blood sugar level to better digestion for a stronger immune system, and more.

feeds.title: The Nourishing Tree Blog
feeds.description: My name is English Goldsborough, Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner, Board Certified in Holistic Nutrition & Certified Lactation Counselor. I aim to empower you with knowledge of your body's innate wisdom and guide you in your journey to natural, holistic healing. I use comprehensive testing as well as different tools and techniques to create personalized nutrition and supplement plan designed with your unique needs in mind.

feeds.title: Well from Within Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lexie Gray, Nutritional Therapy Practitioner and Certified Personal Trainer. Because of what I've experienced, I can now help other women get out of the cycle of guilt, shame, and perfectionism while also pursuing health. If you're a woman in today's world, you're likely overwhelmed and exhausted. I want to help you renew your body and mind so you can wholeheartedly pursue your passions and reclaim your joy!

feeds.title: Chronically Holistic
feeds.description: Hi, I am Kate! The face behind Chronically Holistic. I am a Nutritional Therapy Practitioner (NTP), a pediatric registered nurse and amateur homesteader. I have a passion for Holistic Health with an emphasis on gut health and nutrition. I have years of personal experience with non-textbook chronic migraines, anxiety, and pain.

feeds.title: New Hope Counseling and Wellness Center Blog
feeds.description: Healthy living and a joy filled life can be yours if you get on the right track. Our blog is full of useful tips to help you do just that!

feeds.title: Annika Nicole Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Annika. I became a Nutritional Therapy Practitioner after years of anorexia, binge eating, body dysmorphia, fasting, keto, and trying EVERY fad diet under the sun. My mission and purpose are to help women end the war on their bodies. From hormone healing to self-acceptance, to beat that bloat and constipation that you've never been able to figure out, I put together an individualized protocol for you and then educate you on how to stay feeling good forever.

feeds.title: Autoimmune Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with all of the latest AIP compliant recipes, articles, and other resources on living well with autoimmune disease. I'm Mickey, and I help people find creative solutions to preparing, cooking, and succeeding on allergen-free diets.I'm a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner, certified through the Nutritional Therapy Association, and coach a small number of one-on-one clients.

feeds.title: Health Lifestyles Blog
feeds.description: Read articles written by Nimisha Patel on advice for women struggling with binge & comfort eating, depression & anxiety. Nimisha provides personalized psychotherapy and functional nutrition interventions to help adults manage their moods, binge, and compulsive eating behavior.

feeds.title: Restore Health Lab
feeds.description: Hi! I'm April, a Functional Nutritional Therapy Practitioner, and Certified Holistic Health Coach! I've worked with hundreds of women to regain freedom from their weight, improve hormone function and feel like a teenager again, and support a few high-risk souls in the fight against breast cancer.
